newsitem.title: USA: MIDCOM secures $30 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: MIDCOM secures $30 mln credit facility.

text.p: MIDCOM Communications Inc on Thursday said it reached an agreement on a new revolving credit facility with Foothill Capital Corp.
Under terms of the agreement, the company will be able to borrow up to $30 million secured by eligible billed and unbilled accounts receivable.
The company, which earlier reported a fourth-quarter loss of $1.26 per share, said the fresh financing would provide additional support for its turnaround strategy.

"Fourth-quarter and year-end results were in line with our expectations, and we believe that, at current levels, our revenue stream provides us with a solid platform for growth going forward," MIDCOM Chief Financial Officer Robert Chamberlain said in a statement.
"We've already begun to see evidence of both increased sales and decreased attrition, and we're pleased to have secured additional funding," he said.
